title: Meraki Winter 2021: The Sound of the '80s
summary: Music, technology and daily life in the 1980s, with the club's fiction, poetry and photography.
intro: We have tried to cover everything, from music to technology, to day-to-day life in the '80s. There is too much that the 1980s have brought to life; we hope you will enjoy this historical theme with all its nostalgic value.

articles.heading: A note from the Editor
articles.author: Tasneem Juzer
articles.body:
We are pleased to introduce the Winter Edition of Meraki 2021 to you. This time, we are here to present you with some highlights of the '80s culture and some chosen pieces that touched our hearts.

2021 had been a ride full of ups and downs, so we decided to cap it off with a bang. The Greed Decade (i.e., the 1980s) was a one-of-a-kind decade and was a game-changer in every way.

The journey is just as essential as the destination. Try to embrace the climb.

articles.heading: A note from the President
articles.author: Sujan Ganesh
articles.body:
It is always twists and turns with life, ain't it? One moment you are here, and the next, you are there.

To my lovely juniors, I know adapting to college life is a bit exhaustive, but don't let it get the best of you. Make friends in and out of your department, join clubs and societies, and love yourself before loving anyone else.

Take good care of your health.
